sources.title: Super Intelligence Reached OT Systems and Moved Equipment
Booz Allen Reports Frontier AI Reached All Eight OT Lab Objectives
sources.publisher: Cloud Security Alliance AI Safety Initiative

claims.statement: Booz Allen reported all eight planned objectives completed in its isolated operational technology lab.
In one controlled test models reached the industrial control network in just over sixteen minutes.
In a different test a frontier AI model found and moved a robotic arm within minutes.
Every exploit and action that could have physical consequences required human approval.
Some defenses blocked or slowed actions; these are not real-world unapproved factory attacks.
The models were unnamed and the experiment's results lack full independent public reproduction.
